title: Fetch a Wikipedia page summary
description: One request to the Wikipedia REST API for the summary of one article.
task_text: Use the web_fetch tool exactly once, with this exact URL: https://en.wikipedia.org/api/rest_v1/page/summary/Cloud_computing . Do not retry. Do not call any other tool. Report the actual result that web_fetch returns, then stop immediately.
safety_notes: One public request. The outcome is decided by the active policy and recorded from OpenShell events only.
